'''Karachi Kings''' is a [[Pakistani]] professional [[Twenty20]] franchise [[cricket]] team that will compete in [[2026 Pakistan Super League]]. The team is based in the [[Karachi]] city of [[Pakistan]]. This will be the eleventh consecutive season of the [[Karachi Kings|Kings]] in the [[Pakistan Super League]] after renewing their franchise agreement for another decade in December 2025.<ref>{{cite news |title=Karachi Kings to reign for another decade |url=https://www.pcb.com.pk/press-release-detail/karachi-kings-to-reign-for-another-decade.html |work=PCB |date=2025-11-25}}</ref>

Karachi finished fourth in the [[2025 Pakistan Super League]]. They are currently coached by [[Ravi Bopara]] and [[Captain (cricket)|captained]] by [[David Warner (cricketer)|David Warner]].

==Squad==
[[Pakistan Super League]] introduced [[Player auction|an auction model]] for the first time in the [[2026 Pakistan Super League|2026]] season, allowing teams to select players by bidding in [[Pakistani rupees]].<ref name="D1">{{cite news |title=Player auction model to replace draft system for PSL XI |url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1967839 |work=Dawn |date=19 January 2026 |language=en}}</ref> Teams were also allowed to directly sign one foreign player who was not part of [[2025 Pakistan Super League|previous season]].<ref name="D1" /> Kings signed [[Moeen Ali]] as their directly signed player..<ref name="TribuneAuction">{{cite news |title=PSL 11: Karachi Kings confirm retentions ahead of auction |url=https://tribune.com.pk/story/2590592/psl-11-karachi-kings-confirm-retentions |work=The Express Tribune |date=2026-02-03}}</ref> Teams were also allowed to retain up to 4 players who were part of their squads in previous seasons, while new teams were allowed to sign 4 players before the auction to match with other franchises.<ref>{{cite web |title=PSL auction to take place on 11 February |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/pakistan-news-psl-2026-auction-to-take-place-february-11-1520921 |access-date=10 February 2026}}</ref> Karachi retained [[Khushdil Shah]], [[Saad Baig]], [[Abbas Afridi (cricketer)|Abbas Afridi]] and [[Hasan Ali (cricketer)|Hasan Ali]] from their squad.<ref name="ret">{{cite news |title=PSL 2026 players list: Full squads for all teams and latest updates from Pakistan Super League auction {{!}} Cricket News |url=https://www.cricketnews.com/en/cricket/news/psl-2026-players-list-full-squads-all-teams-pakistan-super-league/3bbd393a06776bf26546351b#:~:text=Players%20who%20were%20not%20retained%20entered%20the,to%20four%20players%20from%20the%20unpicked%20pool. |work=www.cricketnews.com |date=11 February 2026 |language=en}}</ref>

[[2026 Pakistan Super League personnel signings and auction|Player auction]] for the PSL 11 was held on 11 February 2026.<ref name="ret" /> Following is the full squad of [[Karachi Kings]] after the player auction and retentions.<ref name="WisdenAuction">{{cite web |title=PSL 2026 Auction: Direct overseas signings revealed |url=https://www.wisden.com/series/psl-2026/cricket-news/psl-2026-auction-full-list-of-players-with-base-price |work=Wisden |date=2026-02-10}}</ref>
